cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: We're continuing with LightGBM and we're talking about another feature of LightGBM called Leaf-Wise Tree Growth.
cues.zh: 繼續 LightGBM，談另一項功能，依葉節點生長。

cues.en: So let's have a look.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.en: Our usual ordinary tree growth is level-wise tree growth or depth-wise tree growth.
cues.zh: 一般樹是依層級、依深度生長。

cues.en: Those are synonymous terms.
cues.zh: 兩個是同義。

cues.en: And the way it works is, we saw at level one we have a split, then it turns, gives us two values on the ends of the split.
cues.zh: 第一層先切分，兩端得到兩個值。

cues.en: Then we go to level two, we create more splits if necessary, if applicable, then we go to level three and more splits and so on and so on and so on.
cues.zh: 再到第二層，必要時再切，再第三層繼續，以此類推。

cues.en: So that's depth wise or level-wise tree growth.
cues.zh: 這是依深度或層級生長。

cues.en: With LightGBM, it's lighter.
cues.zh: LightGBM 比較輕量。

cues.en: Maybe that's where the name comes from.
cues.zh: 也許因此得名。

cues.en: It's leaf-wise tree growth.
cues.zh: 它依葉節點生長。

cues.en: So we start with an additional split, and then instead of doing it at a level, we just go to one of the leaves and we split it there if necessary.
cues.zh: 先有初始切分，不再逐層做，而是挑一個必要的葉再切。

cues.en: And then, and then once that's done, we go to another one of the leaves.
cues.zh: 完成後，再到另一個葉。

cues.en: We basically, we'll evaluate all of these leaves and we look for where can we get the best gain?
cues.zh: 評估所有葉，找哪裡增益最大。

cues.en: Where can we do the best split out of all three of them?
cues.zh: 三個裡哪個切分最好？

cues.en: If we've had to choose, which we do, we have to choose only one, which one will give us the best result?
cues.zh: 如果只能選一個，而且確實要選一個，哪個結果最佳？

cues.en: We pick that one and we do the split there.
cues.zh: 選那個並切分。

cues.en: Now we have more leaves.
cues.zh: 現在有更多葉。

cues.en: Now again, we look at all of them and we find the one which will give us the best result, might be this one.
cues.zh: 再次全部評估，找結果最好的，也許這個。

cues.en: Okay, we do the split here.
cues.zh: 好，在這裡切。

cues.en: Now we have all these leaves, we pick the one which will give us the best result for a split, and we do that.
cues.zh: 現在有這些葉，再挑最佳位置切分。

cues.en: So we're investing into the best split every time.
cues.zh: 每次都投入最佳切分。

cues.en: And as you can imagine, this is more efficient than the depth wise because, for example, let's say on this level, or let's say on this level when it's doing the splits,
cues.zh: 可以想像比逐層更有效率，例如這層，或這層做分割時，

cues.en: maybe this split is so much better than this one, and then even this one is so much better than this one then what's the point of doing this split if you can just keep going down this pathway?
cues.zh: 也許這個比那個好很多，接下來這個又更好，那不如一直往這條路走，何必先切另一個？

cues.en: And in terms of when does it stop, well, just, there are common stopping conditions and also stopping conditions basically
cues.zh: 何時停止，則有一般停止條件，另外某些條件在這裡

cues.en: that are maybe triggered more often here.
cues.zh: 可能更常觸發。

cues.en: So we've got max depth, right?
cues.zh: 例如 max_depth。

cues.en: So how deep the tree is.
cues.zh: 就是樹有多深。

cues.en: You can tell it to stop after a certain depth.
cues.zh: 可以指定某深度後停止。

cues.en: You can tell it to stop after there's a minimum data in a certain leaf.
cues.zh: 也可依葉內最小資料量停止。

cues.en: So you're not gonna split this leaf if there's less than a certain number of observations, like a hundred or, I don't know, 200 observations, or 10 observations in here.
cues.zh: 少於特定筆數就不切，例如 100、200 或 10 筆。

cues.en: Minimum gain to split.
cues.zh: 最小分割增益。

cues.en: You know, you can always set a threshold for what's the minimum gain that you require for a split to occur and number of leaves.
cues.zh: 可設門檻，要求切分至少有多少增益，以及葉節點數量。

cues.en: So that's a powerful one.
cues.zh: 這是很有用的條件。

cues.en: So by growing it this way, you might get to, let's say, a certain number of leaves and you wanna stop there.
cues.zh: 這樣長到特定葉數，就可停止。

cues.en: I think by default the parameter is set to 31.
cues.zh: 我想預設是 31。

cues.en: And yeah, so this way you will end up building a tree always with the best split out of all possible splits at every single step.
cues.zh: 所以每一步，都從所有可能分割中挑最佳，建立樹。

cues.en: So there we go, that's how LightGBM lightens up the tree growth approach.
cues.zh: 這就是 LightGBM 讓樹生長更輕量的方法。

cues.en: And I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning!
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧！
